comparisons.peer_topic: Diversity, Belonging and Inclusion (DB&I) Philosophy and Strategy
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD believes that building a diverse talent pipeline, encouraging a culture of respect and belonging, and increasing inclusion of unique voices strengthens the company. This approach includes fostering an environment where employees share diverse opinions and perspectives.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVIDIA and AMD articulate a strategic belief that a diverse workforce and inclusive culture are critical for business strength and innovation. NVIDIA explicitly states that 'diverse teams fuel innovation' and aims to build a talent pipeline including women and underrepresented minorities. Similarly, AMD states that 'building a diverse talent pipeline... makes our company stronger' and that such a workforce encourages employees to 'share their opinions and different perspectives.' Both disclosures emphasize the pipeline aspect of diversity as a core component of their human capital strategy.

sentences.text: We believe that diverse teams fuel innovation, and we are committed to creating an inclusive culture that supports all employees.

When recruiting for new talent or developing our current employees, we strive to build a diverse talent pipeline that includes those underrepresented in the technology field, including women, Black/African American, and Hispanic/Latino candidates.
Our diverse and inclusive workforce encourages employees to share their opinions and different perspectives.
We believe that building a diverse talent pipeline, encouraging a culture of respect and belonging, and increasing inclusion of unique and underrepresented voices makes our company stronger.

comparisons.peer_summary: In 2024, AMD continued to focus on developing its female engineering community through mentoring opportunities and expanding the 'Advancing Women in Technology' program, which aims to support the career development of women in technical careers.
comparisons.comparison: While both companies address the development of women in technology, their specific programmatic focus differs. NVIDIA supports the 'development of women employees through programs aimed at building a pipeline of future leaders' and provides 'executive sponsors.' AMD, in contrast, details specific technical career development efforts, citing the continuation of 'Advancing Women in Technology' which aims to 'support the career development of women in technical careers' through mentoring opportunities. Both demonstrate a commitment to women's advancement, but AMD's disclosure highlights a specific named program for technical roles, whereas NVIDIA's describes broader leadership and sponsorship structures.

sentences.text: • Supporting the development of women employees through programs aimed at building a pipeline of future leaders;

In 2024, we continued to focus on developing our female engineering community through mentoring opportunities and expanding the program, "Advancing Women in Technology," that aims to support the career development of women in technical careers at AMD.
